sentence: For instance, it favours cool, dry conditions and crowded indoor spaces with poor ventilation.
translation: 例如，它偏爱凉爽干燥的环境，以及通风不良的拥挤室内空间。
analysis: favour 熟词僻义：（条件）有利于、（病毒）偏爱（呼应必修三 U4 的 Fortune favours the prepared mind——同一动词的科学语境版）| cool, dry conditions：双形容词逗号并列 | crowded indoor spaces with poor ventilation：with 短语补条件（通风差）| For instance 举例衔接 | 病毒拟人化的“偏好清单”：把传播条件写成性格偏好——科普把抽象机理翻译成生活画面的技巧；防疫建议（通风！）藏在反面
pattern: For instance, S + favours + adj., adj. + N and + adj. + N + with poor + N
imitationCn: 例如，霉菌偏爱温暖潮湿的角落，以及光照不足的封闭橱柜。
imitationHint: For instance, mould favours warm, damp corners → and closed cupboards with poor lighting（favour = 偏爱）
imitationAnswer: For instance, mould favours warm, damp corners and closed cupboards with poor lighting.

sentence: Ordinary people from all walks of life united in helping those affected by the pandemic.
translation: 各行各业的普通人团结起来，帮助受疫情影响的人们。
analysis: from all walks of life 各行各业（呼应选必一 U3 清明上河图——同词块从古画走进现实抗疫）| unite in doing 团结起来做某事（in + 动名词表所团结之事）| those affected by...：those + 过去分词后置定语（= those who were affected）| ordinary people 普通人的分量：抗疫叙事的主角不是英雄是凡人 | pandemic 大流行病（pan- 全+demos 民）| 全民抗疫的群像句：普通+各业+团结三要素——共克时艰类作文的中心句
pattern: Ordinary people from all walks of life united in + V-ing + those + V-ed by ...
imitationCn: 各行各业的普通人团结起来，援助受洪灾影响的乡亲。
imitationHint: Ordinary people from all walks of life united in → aiding those affected by the floods（unite in doing + those + 分词）
imitationAnswer: Ordinary people from all walks of life united in aiding those affected by the floods.

sentence: Once the virus multiplies, infected cells multiply the danger to the whole body.
translation: 病毒一旦增殖，被感染的细胞就会成倍放大对全身的威胁。
analysis: multiply 一词双用：前句不及物“增殖”（病毒自我复制），后句及物“成倍增加”（细胞放大危险）——同词异性的修辞回环 | Once 引导条件/时间从句“一旦”| infected cells：过去分词作前置定语 | the danger to 对……的威胁 | 病理机制的多米诺句：病毒→细胞→全身的三级扩散一句推完——机理说明的因果链写法
pattern: Once + S + multiplies, + V-ed + N + multiply the danger to ...
imitationCn: 谣言一旦扩散，恐慌的人群就会成倍放大对整个社区的伤害。
imitationHint: Once rumours multiply, panicked crowds multiply → the harm to the whole community（multiply 双用）
imitationAnswer: Once rumours multiply, panicked crowds multiply the harm to the whole community.
